name: class-student-directory-portal
description: Class Student Directory & Collaboration Portal — full-stack monorepo

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run prisma:migrate --prefix server && npm run seed --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
